assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent PNG sprite atlas for Regavo 2D isometric historical RTS, medieval DAI VIET of Vietnam inspired by Ly, Tran and early Le archaeological architecture. Create exactly TWELVE completely isolated buildings in an evenly spaced FOUR-column THREE-row grid on true transparent background, landscape 1536x1024. No text, labels, grid lines, background or checkerboard. Each building completely inside its equal 384x341 cell, generous transparent padding. Fixed orthographic 2:1 isometric view, front facing lower right, warm upper-left daylight, finely painted semi-realistic muted bitmap style, crisp silhouettes, no cartoon or glossy 3D. Vietnamese timber framing, restrained curved tiled roofs, brick courts, lotus and slender dragon roof ornaments, earthy red, bronze-gold, dark wood and jade-green glazed tile. This is development tier 1, NOT a chronological dynasty switch. Modest compact wooden halls and earth/brick bases, simple terracotta roofs, minimal decoration. Buildings read as Dai Viet, not generic Tang buildings or Nguyen-era Hue reconstructions. Row1 left-to-right: OPEN-COURTYARD royal town-center hall with small red standard bearing a gold dragon motif, no surrounding perimeter wall; modest civilian HOUSE; BARRACKS with spear racks and shield stands; STABLE with low tiled shelter and empty horse enclosure. Row2: ARCHERY RANGE with straw targets; MARKET with pottery and woven baskets stalls; GRANARY with rice sacks and baskets; LUMBER CAMP with logs and saw benches. Row3: MINING CAMP with tools and ore baskets; TIMBER WORKSHOP with carpentry tools, no gun or cannon; TILED WATCHTOWER; modest FORTRESS hall with defensive brick platform. Every structure sits on a small symmetric 2:1 diamond square foundation fully visible. No people, no readable writing, no surrounding landscape. Coherent scale, town hall is the largest, complete silhouettes and genuine alpha transparency.
